qe: Which state of India has the largest reserves of coal, although another state usually leads in annual coal production?
qh: भारत में कोयले के सबसे बड़े भंडार किस राज्य में हैं, यद्यपि वार्षिक उत्पादन में सामान्यतः कोई अन्य राज्य आगे रहता है?
oe: Jharkhand; Chhattisgarh usually leads in production
Odisha; West Bengal leads in reserves
West Bengal; Jharkhand usually leads in production
oh: झारखंड; उत्पादन में सामान्यतः छत्तीसगढ़ आगे
ओडिशा; भंडार में पश्चिम बंगाल आगे
पश्चिम बंगाल; उत्पादन में सामान्यतः झारखंड आगे
e: Koyla bharat ki urja ka sabse bada strot hai aur bharat duniya ke sabse bade koyla utpadak deshon me ginta hai. Bhandaar (reserves) ke hisaab se dekhein to Jharkhand sabse aage hai, iske baad Odisha aur Chhattisgarh aate hain. Lekin varshana utpadan me Chhattisgarh aksar sabse upar rahta hai, isliye 'bhandaar' aur 'utpadan' - in do alag-baatein ko mila dena hi is prashn ki asli chunauti hai. Isi wajah se Jharkhand ka bhandaar tatha Chhattisgarh ka utpadan - dono vikalp sahi jode me nahi aate. Pashchim bengal me bhi koyla (Raniganj) nikalta hai, lekin na bhandaar me na utpadan me woh pehle sthan par hai; isliye uske naam wale dono vikalp galat hain. Coal India Limited (CIL) desh ki mukhya sarkari koyla kampany hai, aur Bharat Coking Coal jaisi uski anukein special coking coal nikaalti hain. Exam point: koyla bhandaar me Jharkhand pratham, utpadan me Chhattisgarh aksar pratham; coking coal ke liye Jharia (Jharkhand) prasiddh.

qe: The Jharia coalfield of Jharkhand is famous for which specific mineral resource?
qh: झारखंड का झरिया कोयला-क्षेत्र किस विशिष्ट खनिज संसाधन के लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
oe: Iron ore of the highest grade
e: Jharia coalfield Jharkhand ke Dhanbad jile me hai aur yeh bharat ki sabse mahatvapurn coking coal ka kshetra hai. Coking coal (koking koyla) woh koyla hai jisse coke banta hai, aur coke ispat banaane ke liye zaroori hai kyunki woh bhathi me lohe ko galane me madad karta hai. Yahi karan hai ki Jharia tatha uske aas-paas ke kshetra Ispat ke liye itne mahatvapurn hain ki yahan 1970 ke dashak me koyla kshetra ka rashtriyakaran (nationalisation) kiya gaya tatha Bharat Coking Coal Limited bani. Iron ore ke liye prasiddh kshetra alag hain - jaise Odisha me Badbil, Jharkhand me Noamundi tatha Chhattisgarh me Bailadila; bauxite ke liye Odisha (Kalahandi-Koraput) aur manganese ke liye Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra tatha Odisha jaane jaate hain. Isliye is prashn me anya khanij wale vikalp galat hain. Dhyaan rahe - Jharia me bhoomi ke niche aag lag jaane ki samasya bhi saamne aati hai. Exam point: Jharia (Jharkhand) = sabse mahatvapurn coking coal kshetra; coke ispat nirmaan me kaam aata hai.

qe: The Bailadila iron ore mines, from where iron ore is exported to Japan through a dedicated port, are located in which state?
qh: जिन बैलाडीला लोह अयस्क खदानों से समर्पित पत्तन के माध्यम से जापान को लोह अयस्क निर्यात होता है, वे किस राज्य में स्थित हैं?
e: Bailadila ki pahadiyan Chhattisgarh ke Dantewada jile me hain aur yahan duniya ke sabse achhe darje ka hematite iron ore nikalta hai. Yahan ka ore Japan ko bhejne ke liye Vishakhapatnam tatha Kakinada jaisa bandargah use hota hai, aur bharat ki pehli 'slurry pipeline' bhi yahin se judi hui hai. Lokpriya prasiddhi ke kaaran log ise Odisha ka hissa samajh lete hain, lekin Bailadila sa Dayta hai ki woh Chhattisgarh me hai; isi karan Odisha wala vikalp galat hai. Odisha me iron ore ke bade kshetra alag hain - Badbil, Khandadhar tatha Joda; isi tarah Jharkhand me Noamundi prasiddh hai aur Karnataka me Ballari-Bababudan ka belt hai. Is prashn ka asli uddeshya rajya ke naam aur khanij belt ke sahi sanyojan ko test karna hai. Rourkela (Odisha) ispat sankul ko Odisha ke khazanah se tatak sanyantr se ore milta hai, lekin Bailadila wahan nahi hai. Exam point: Bailadila = Chhattisgarh (Dantewada), hematite loh ore, Japan ko niryat, Vishakhapatnam phatak; isi tarah Badbil aur Joda Odisha me hain.

qe: India's uranium is mainly mined at Jaduguda and nearby areas, which are located in which state, and by which organisation?
qh: भारत का यूरेनियम मुख्यतः जादुगुड़ा तथा आसपास के क्षेत्रों में खनन किया जाता है, जो किस राज्य में हैं और किस संस्था द्वारा?
oe: Jharkhand; Uranium Corporation of India Limited
Chhattisgarh; Nuclear Power Corporation of India
oh: झारखंड; यूरेनियम कार्पोरेशन ऑफ इंडिया लिमिटेड
e: Bharat ka uranium vah mukhya roop se Jharkhand ke Jaduguda tatha uske aas-paas ke bhaag me nikalta hai, aur yah kaam Uranium Corporation of India Limited (UCIL) karti hai, jo bharat sarkar ka enterprises hai. Jharkhand ka Singhbhum belt sabse purana tatha pramukh uranium kshetra hai; yahan Singhbhum Shear Zone me uranium ore milta hai. Kai log uranium ko nuclear power plant wali sanstha se milaa dete hain, lekin Nuclear Power Corporation of India (NPCIL) bijli utpadan karti hai, khanan nahi; isliye Chhattisgarh wala vikalp galat hai. Meghalaya me Kylleng-Pyndengsohiong (Domiasiat) kshetra uranium ke liye jaana jaata hai, lekin woh bharat ka mukhya utpadan sthal nahi bana; BARC ek research centre hai. Atomic Minerals Directorate exploration par kaam karta hai, khanan UCIL karti hai; isliye Andhra Pradesh wala vikalp bhi galat hai. Exam point: uranium khanan = Jaduguda, Jharkhand, UCIL ke dwara; NPCIL bijli banati hai, khanan nahin.

qe: The Bhadla Solar Park, one of the largest solar parks in the world, is located in which state?
qh: दुनिया के सबसे बड़े सौर पार्कों में एक, भड़ला सौर पार्क किस राज्य में स्थित है?
e: Bhadla Solar Park Rajasthan ke Jodhpur tatha Bikaner ke beech Jodhpur jile ke Bhadla gaon kshetra me hai aur yah duniya ke sabse bade solar parks me gina jaata hai. Yahan dhoop ka karan aise kshetra me solar bijli ka nirmaan bharat ke liye sabse sasta saabit hua, aur isi park ke kararan solar tarif ka record nicha level tak pahuncha. Rajasthan me hi aur bhi solar parks hain - jaise Jaisalmer aur Jodhpur kshetra; Gujarat me Charanka solar park pramukh hai, isliye pehla vikalp galat hai. Karnataka me Pavagada solar park hai tatha Madhya Pradesh me Rewa solar park prasiddh hai - dono bade yojanaayein hain, lekin Bhadla nahi hain. Is prashn me sansthha tatha bhoogol ka sahi milan test hota hai; answer keval Rajasthan hai. Exam point: Bhadla solar park = Rajasthan (Jodhpur ke paas, Thar kshetra); Pavagada = Karnataka, Rewa = Madhya Pradesh, Charanka = Gujarat.

qe: The oldest oil refinery in India, established in the late nineteenth century, is located at:
qh: भारत की सबसे पुरानी तेल-शोधनशाला, जो उन्नीसवीं सदी के अंत में स्थापित हुई, कहाँ स्थित है?
e: Bharat ki sabse purani tel shodhanshala (oil refinery) Digboi, Assam me hai; yah 1901 me British ke samay shuru hui, jabki wahan 1889-90 se tel ki khoj tatha khadee chal rahi thi. Isiliye ise 'bharat ki tel nagari' kaha jaata hai. Iske baad aane wali badi shodhan shalayein alag hain - 1950-60 ke dashak me Assam me Guwahati tatha Barauni (Bihar) ki shodhan shalayein bani, aur 1960 ke dashak me Gujarat (Koyali) tatha Maharashtra (Trombay) me shodhan shalaya khuli. Jamnagar (Gujarat) me duniya ki sabse badi ek hi jagah ki shodhan shala (Reliance) hai - woh prasiddh hai, lekin sabse purani nahi, isliye woh vikalp galat hai. Barauni tatha Koyali dono aadhunik raashtriya shodhan shalayein hain, unka nama sabse purani hone ke liye nahi aata. Exam point: sabse purani shodhan shala = Digboi, Assam (1901); sabse badi ek-jagah shodhan shala = Jamnagar, Gujarat; Barauni = Bihar ki pramukh shodhan shala.

qe: India's first nuclear power station was set up at Tarapur in Maharashtra; which country helped India build it, and in which decade did it begin operation?
qh: भारत का पहला परमाणु ऊर्जा केंद्र महाराष्ट्र के तारापुर में स्थापित किया गया; इसे बनाने में किस देश ने सहायता की और यह किस दशक में चालू हुआ?
e: Tarapur Atomic Power Station Maharashtra ke Thane jile me hai aur yah bharat ka pehla parmanu bijli kendr tha. Iska nirmaan America ke sahayog se hua (General Electric dwara, light water reactor), aur isne 1969 me bijli banana shuru kiya, isliye sahi jawab 1960 ka dashak hai. Bhartiya parmanu karyakram ke janak Homi Bhabha the aur Apsara research reactor 1956 me chalu hua tha, lekin woh bijli ke liye nahi tha. Baad me bharat ne doosri tarah ke reactors banaye - Rajasthan ka Rawatbhata Canada ke sahayog se (CANDU type) tatha Kudankulam (Tamil Nadu) Russia ke sahayog se, jo bharat ka sabse bada parmanu bijli kendr hai. Isliye Russia aur Canada wale vikalp galat ho jaate hain kyunki woh pehle kendr se nahi, baad ke kendron se jude hain. France ke sahayog se bharat ne nirmaan ki koi bada reactor nahi banaya. Exam point: pehla parmanu bijli kendr = Tarapur, Maharashtra (ameriki sahayog se, 1969 me chalu); Kudankulam = Russia, sabse bada; Rawatbhata = Canada ki technIQe.
